residual_and_limits.closed_period: FY2024 -> FY2025 (both already reported and closed)
residual_and_limits.residual_derivation: 349,079,082,852 - 303,639,957,153 x 1.1496 = 349,079,082,852 - 349,064,494,743.0888 = 14,588,108.9112 CNY. Recomputed with python Decimal in evidence/M01/oracle.json; the exact ratio of the two disclosed figures is 14.9648% versus the 14.96% printed by the issuer, so the residual is dominated by the issuer's 2-decimal rounding plus the genuine mix/scope effects the model cannot express.
residual_and_limits.interpretation: Even when handed the issuer's own disclosed growth rate, a single-rate direct_growth path misses the realised revenue by about CNY 14.59 million (0.0042% of the disclosed figure). The model cannot express volume/price mix, equity production accounting, intercompany elimination, M&A consolidation, FX, or the commodity price cycle, and it cannot decompose this residual. This is why the card grants a FORMULA qualification only and this attempt grants NO accuracy claim.
residual_and_limits.not_a_forecast: historical_mapping_probe only; FY2025 was already public when this attempt ran, so this is NOT an out-of-sample forecast and NOT accuracy evidence.

unmapped_reasons: D requires per-driver mapping signed by an industry/accounting reviewer plus reconciliation of one closed period against the production forecast entry point (scripts/forecast/segments.py calculate_model_path); those are I-10-A obligations and have NOT been reviewed.
The reviewer field of every mapping entry is PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW by construction.
No production forecast entry point was exercised in this attempt (no I-11 parameter calibration, no I-07-E wiring).
accuracy_reasons: F requires the I-12 frozen design (information-time sample, baseline, statistical uncertainty). That design does not exist yet.
No out-of-sample rolling evaluation was run; the single closed-period probe above is explicitly not accuracy evidence.
